prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a sideswipe while changing lanes. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1334; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Inspection of the vehicle shows scraping and paint transfer along the right rear quarter panel, a cracked rear bumper cover end, and a dented rear door skin with a broken side marker lens. The damage pattern lines up well with a sideswipe during a lane change, and nothing observed points to a different cause. The repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover, refinishing and blending the quarter panel and door, and swapping the marker lens, with the labor hours sized to that scope. No prior damage to this vehicle is known from our records or the owner's account. The invoices submitted so far show no duplicated or repeated charges.
